snippet.title: Zombie Cleaner – Official Gameplay Trailer | Somebody Has to Clean This Up
snippet.description:
Somebody has to clean up after the zombie apocalypse. Wishlist Zombie Cleaner on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5080340/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=wishlist&utm_content=trailer

Zombie Cleaner is a top-down incremental game where you mop up the mess the undead leave behind, while more of them keep showing up. Scrub the blood, bag what's left, haul it to the bin and get paid, then spend it on better gear, more helpers and upgrades that turn one tired janitor into a cleaning empire.

🧽 Clean, haul, get paid: scrub stains, peel bodies off the floor and pour every load into the bin.
🔦 Work in the dark: you only see zombies inside your flashlight, but you can hear them coming.
🧟 Fight back: bat, pistol, shotgun and assault rifle, plus skills like Bleach Storm and Bullet Spray.
🧑‍🔧 Hire help: interns, a robot vacuum, a guard dog and more clean and fight alongside you.
👹 Bosses: every zone ends with a boss, starting with Patient Zero.
🏢 Sell the franchise: prestige as Dead Tidy Co. and start again with permanent upgrades.
🤝 Play solo or online with a friend.

📅 Coming to Steam (PC) on December 15, 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5080340/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=wishlist&utm_content=trailer
